description: A linear fader for one parameter, vertical or horizontal: a press on the track, a drag of the thumb, wheel, keys, graduations, an anchor, and the change's source for an agent. Its svelte adapter.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
import type { FaderPublicState } from "../../../../audio-ui/logic/fader/fader";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

/** The thumb, with the native input that carries the fader's name inside it. */
let {
  "aria-label": label,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Thumb>, "aria-label" | "children"> & {
  "aria-label"?: string;
  children?: Snippet<[FaderPublicState]>;
  getAriaValueText?: (
    formatted: string,
    value: number,
    index: number
  ) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Thumb {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {@render content?.(state)}
    <parts.Input aria-label={label} {getAriaValueText} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Thumb>

<script lang="ts">
import type { FaderPublicState } from "../../../../audio-ui/logic/fader/fader";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

let {
  children: content,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Value>, "children"> & {
  children?: Snippet<[FaderPublicState]>;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Value {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {#if content}
      {@render content(state)}
    {:else}
      {state.formatted}
    {/if}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Value>
